title: Quarantine Prompt Injection in Tool Output
signature: class InjectionGuard: __init__(rules, min_len=6), wrap(call_id, tool, text) -> str, check_call(call_id, tool, arguments, approved) -> dict
hints: Collect spans rule by rule with re.finditer(..., re.IGNORECASE). Skip a match that is empty or overlaps a span you already kept, then sort the kept spans by start.
Escape the original text between and inside spans (& first, then < and >). The markers you insert are the only unescaped brackets.
Remember the original text of every span, stripped or flagged. Stripping hides it from the model, not from the attacker's plan.
Taint is containment in either direction, case-insensitive, after strip(), and only for values of at least min_len characters. Walk dicts and lists and build dotted paths.
